baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired occurrences of calling at words 4 and 17, the negated response at word 10, the temporal limit at words 13-14, and recipient heedlessness at word 18.
baseline_models.mechanism: A caller repeatedly sends address toward a recipient, but the relation has no return path: no answering speech comes back, the address is not registered at the far end, and the failure persists across the whole interval to resurrection.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a spoken summons that is directed outward and functions as the initiating signal in the failed exchange.
The branch supplies returned speech and functions as the missing reciprocal act.
The branch places something outside active awareness and functions as failure to register the incoming address.
The branch supplies an extended duration and makes the nonresponse a sustained condition rather than a momentary delay.
The branch supplies resurrection as the terminal event that bounds the failed exchange.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that prayer to a false recipient is misguided.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses misguidance as maintaining a communicative relation whose addressee neither returns nor registers the address through the entire present horizon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two uses of the calling root at words 4 and 17 can carry both address and asserted entitlement or affiliation; words 6-7 set the claimed patron beside God, while words 10 and 18 deny recognition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling can be an assertion that another power bears a right, affiliation, or patronal role. The alleged patron never ratifies that standing: it supplies no answer and may be read either as unaware of the claim or as withholding recognition from it.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a claimed right or affiliation and makes the call an attempted status relation, not only a request.
The branch supplies an alternative or lower-ranked party and locates the asserted patronage outside God.
The branch supplies an answering return and functions as the absent ratification of the caller's claim.
The branch permits deliberate disregard and keeps active nonrecognition live beside simple unawareness.

changed_reading.before: Calling is only a petition for aid.
changed_reading.after: Calling may also install an alleged patron or affiliation, and the ayah exposes a status claim that its supposed counterparty never acknowledges.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at word 6 admits what is nearer, lower, or short of the goal, while words 13-14 extend the test to resurrection and word 2 names loss of direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The error can be read spatially and temporally: dependence stops at a nearer or lower substitute and treats an intermediate endpoint as ultimate. Resurrection exposes that this shortened horizon cannot carry the caller to the intended goal.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies nearness that falls short of an endpoint and makes the substitute a prematurely terminal station.
The branch supplies deviation from a destination and makes the shortened horizon a directional error.
The branch supplies the long duration against which a merely near-term dependency is tested.
The branch supplies the final rising that reveals whether the chosen endpoint can endure beyond proximity.

changed_reading.before: The construction means only choosing a different deity.
changed_reading.after: It can additionally expose a horizon error: elevating what is nearer, lower, or intermediate into an ultimate point of dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding challenge treats the invoked relation as a claim that should leave evidence of standing: a creative contribution, an actual share, an establishing record, or a surviving trace. Their absence turns 46:5's lack of answer into lack of title as well as lack of efficacy.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an asserted right or affiliation and anchors the evidentiary test in the focus call.
The repeated branch makes the preceding invocation the same attempted claim whose standing is then tested.
The branch supplies origination and functions as the demanded evidence of effective agency.
The branch supplies actual participation and tests whether the alleged patron owns any share in the claimed domain.
The branch supplies an authoritative establishment that would confer binding standing, but none is produced.
The branch supplies a surviving mark that could attest a prior claim and functions as the final missing evidentiary residue.

structural_cues: 46:4 immediately repeats the call-and-besides-God construction, then demands created contribution, share, prior record, or knowledgeable trace before 46:5 declares the relation unanswered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a claim-like calling branch and a sequence of evidentiary demands; I infer that those demands test the patron's title and that nonresponse confirms failed standing. A live alternative is that 46:4 tests power and truth only, without legal or affiliative coloring.

changed_reading.before: The supposed recipient is condemned because it cannot grant a request.
changed_reading.after: The supposed recipient is also an unratified claimant: it has no demonstrated share, record, trace, or answering recognition that could establish patronal standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the gathering, passive nonregistration changes phase: the former recipients become adversaries and repudiate the very worship that had addressed them. The silence of 46:5 is therefore not a neutral vacancy; it is the prehistory of a relation that reverses against its initiator when all parties are assembled.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies present nonregistration and functions as the initial passive state of the relationship.
The branch supplies resurrection and marks the phase boundary after which passive distance becomes active opposition.
The branch supplies the driving together of a group toward one destination and forces the separated parties into confrontation.
The branch supplies explicit enmity and turns absent reciprocity into hostile reciprocity.
The branch supplies submissive worship and identifies the relationship that the recipients later reject.
The branch supplies repudiation and functions as the recipients' eventual counter-position toward the callers' worship.

structural_cues: 46:6 follows without a topic break and changes the recipients' predicate from heedless through the present interval to enemies and repudiators at collective gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal adjacency, gathering, enmity, and repudiation; I infer a phase change in one relationship from ignored address to adversarial counter-relation. The alternative is a simpler contrast between present incapacity and future testimony without a developmental mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply inert or unaware and therefore useless.
changed_reading.after: Their present silence matures into active disavowal: the relation sought by the caller eventually returns, but as enmity rather than aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer-like address in 46:15 asks for enabled gratitude, acceptable work, and repair across generations; 46:16 follows with acceptance and passing over faults. This supplies a positive contrast in which answering is not merely audible speech but effective uptake that changes action, relation, and outcome.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies reply to a request and anchors the question of what counts as a real answer.
The branch supplies directed verbal appeal and anchors the later positive address as a contrastive call.
The branch supplies movement away from corruption and makes repair in deed and descendants part of the requested effect.
The branch supplies willing acceptance and functions as operative uptake of the preceding address.
The branch supplies leaving blame unexacted and gives the answer a consequential form rather than a merely verbal one.

structural_cues: 46:15 contains a first-person address to the Lord with three coordinated requests; 46:16 immediately shifts to first-person divine acceptance, pardon, and promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request followed by acceptance and pardon; I infer that adjacency presents enacted response as the positive foil to 46:5's nonresponse. A live alternative is that 46:16 states a general promise rather than narrating an individualized answer.

changed_reading.before: Response means that the invoked party speaks back or grants a discrete request.
changed_reading.after: Response can be recognized as effective acceptance: the address enters a relation that repairs conduct, receives work, and alters the caller's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between consumed benefits in the nearer life and reckoning on the decisive day gives the focus construction a horizon-specific force. A substitute can be any proximate benefit treated as sufficient and enjoyed to exhaustion, even though it cannot answer across the longer horizon.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a near but goal-short position and anchors the reading in the focus construction.
The branch supplies the longer temporal span that exposes the inadequacy of a near-term endpoint.
The branch supplies the nearer or lower life and concretizes the short horizon as worldly existence.
The branch supplies enjoyed utility and makes immediate benefit the attractive mechanism of substitution.
The branch supplies the day's severe event and functions as the moment when consumed proximity is judged.

structural_cues: 46:20 opposes benefits exhausted in the nearer life to recompense on the presented day, reproducing the focus contrast between a short endpoint and resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical proximity, enjoyed benefits, and a later day of exposure; I infer that a near benefit can function as the depended-on substitute in 46:5. The alternative keeps the focus construction strictly personal and cultic, with no extension to impersonal goods.

changed_reading.before: The substitute is necessarily a named supernatural being.
changed_reading.after: The mechanism can include proximate worldly benefit elevated into ultimate reliance: useful now, consumed now, but unable to answer at the longer horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: People equipped with hearing, sight, and inward apprehension receive no saving benefit from those faculties while knowingly denying signs. They reproduce on the caller side the same failed uptake attributed to the invoked recipients: sensory possession without responsive reception.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies absence from active awareness and anchors the mirrored failure of reception.
The branch supplies responsive return and makes failed uptake, not mere physical capacity, the relational issue.
The branch supplies understanding and compliance, showing the response that bare possession of hearing failed to produce.
The branch supplies inward discernment and turns sight into a capacity that can remain functionally unopened.
The branch supplies the inwardly kindled heart and completes a reception system that nevertheless yields no benefit.
The branch supplies sufficiency and marks the faculties' failure to provide any effective protection.
The branch supplies denial despite knowledge and identifies an active blockage within the human receiver.

structural_cues: 46:26 first lists three receptive faculties, then repeats all three as failing to avail, and finally gives denial of signs as the condition under which they fail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact faculties, zero benefit, and knowledgeable denial; I infer a mirror between humans who do not receive God's signs and recipients who do not receive human calls. The alternative treats 46:26 only as a historical warning about unused faculties, without reciprocal mirroring to 46:5.

changed_reading.before: Heedlessness belongs only to the distant objects being called.
changed_reading.after: The surah reflects nonresponsiveness back onto the callers: one can possess every receiving organ yet function like the unresponsive recipient one depends on.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alleged deities were adopted as offerings or means of proximity and therefore expected to become helping intermediaries. At crisis they do not merely stay silent; they are lost from their dependents, revealing the mediation structure itself as a truth-diverting fabrication.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an alternative intermediary and anchors the failed mediation in the focus construction.
The branch supplies loss of an object and keeps disappearance live inside the focus diagnosis of misguidance.
The branch supplies aid that makes explicit the practical return expected from the intermediaries.
The branch supplies an offering used to seek nearness and explains why the substitutes were installed as mediators.
The branch supplies literal loss from one's possession or location and turns nonresponse into disappearance at need.
The branch supplies falsehood diverted from truth and identifies the vanished mediation structure as fabricated.

structural_cues: 46:28 repeats the besides-God construction and then asks why the adopted proximity-deities did not help, answering that they were lost from their dependents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness-seeking intermediaries, expected help, disappearance, and fabrication; I infer that the focus call invests in a mediation architecture whose promised link fails. The alternative reads the later verse only as another example of powerless idols, without emphasizing mediation.

changed_reading.before: The false recipient remains present but passively refuses or cannot answer.
changed_reading.after: The relation promises mediated closeness and help, yet the intermediary itself vanishes at the point of need; the route, not only the reply, was fabricated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The listening beings first model reception, then command their people to answer God's caller; refusal to answer is named manifest straying and is paired with inability to escape or find alternate protectors. The focus relation is inverted: the crucial question becomes not only whether one's chosen recipient answers, but whether one answers the valid caller.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the initiating summons and anchors both directions of the later role reversal.
The branch supplies answering return and anchors the predicate reassigned from false recipients to human hearers.
The branch supplies hearing that becomes understanding and compliance, initiating the successful reception chain.
The branch supplies attentive silence and functions as the receptive opposite of heedless nonregistration.
The branch supplies an imperative to return an answer and transfers responsibility for response onto the hearers.
The branch supplies God's caller as the valid source whose summons should successfully incline the audience.
The branch supplies refused response and makes the hearer's own nonanswer the decisive failure.
The branch supplies attempted escape from pursuit and denies that nonresponders can outrun the consequence.
The branch supplies protective alliance and marks the alternate support that the nonresponder will not possess.
The branch supplies an alternative outside God and directly repeats the focus location of failed reliance.
The branch supplies manifest directional deviation and explicitly names the condition produced by refusing the valid caller.

structural_cues: 46:29-32 forms a reception chain: hear, attend, return to warn, answer God's caller, and then classify failure to answer as manifest straying with no alternate protectors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same call and answer roots with subject and object roles reversed, plus an explicit straying predicate; I infer deliberate relational inversion of 46:5. The alternative is simple thematic repetition without making the worshipper's own responsiveness part of the focus diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance consists in choosing an addressee that never answers the caller.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance is reciprocal and diagnostic: one calls an unresponsive substitute while becoming the person who will not answer the valid divine summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The terminal day in 46:5 becomes an appointed phase boundary rather than an indefinitely remote date. Creative power restores the dead, exposure elicits verbal acknowledgment from former deniers, and the long wait contracts in perception when the promised event is seen. The false recipient's nonresponse is thus measured against a horizon of restored agency and compelled disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the duration of nonresponse and anchors the later compression of that interval.
The branch supplies resurrection and anchors the transition from present silence to final exposure.
The branch supplies effective power to act and identifies the agency capable of crossing the resurrection boundary.
The branch supplies loss of life and power as the state that divine capability reverses.
The branch supplies the day's severe event and turns the temporal endpoint into an enacted confrontation.
The branch supplies overt speech and shows verbal response emerging under final presentation, though not from the former substitute.
The branch supplies an event fixed to an appointment and makes the horizon determined rather than vague.
The branch supplies duration spent in a state and functions as the interval retrospectively compressed.
The branch supplies daylight opening and bounds the remembered interval within a small visible portion of time.

structural_cues: 46:33 asserts power over the dead, 46:34 stages spoken acknowledgment on the presented day, and 46:35 says sight of the promised event makes prior duration seem only a brief part of daylight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restored life, final dialogue, an appointed promise, and compressed perceived duration; I infer that the focus endpoint is a qualitative phase change in agency and disclosure. The alternative reads these as separate eschatological details that do not modify the force of 'until' in 46:5.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection day is only a remote deadline emphasizing how long the recipient stays silent.
changed_reading.after: It is the phase boundary at which agency is restored, truth forces acknowledgment, and the apparently immense delay collapses, exposing who could ever answer and who could not.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the response root through cutting and opening images, including a form-distant garment aperture. It remains anchored in the negated response at focus word 10 and gains contextual support from attentive reception in 46:29. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for communication, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated response verb at word 10 can be explored through the packet's penetration and opening branches while the call at words 4 and 17 supplies what would need to cross.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a cut that passes through material and makes response a path opened across separation.
The branch supplies an opened clearing and functions as receptive space in which an address could arrive.
The non-dominant branch supplies a garment aperture and sharpens the exploratory inside-to-outside channel analogy.
The branch supplies attentive quiet and functions as the receiving aperture that the focus recipients lack.

changed_reading.before: The recipients simply do not utter a reply.
changed_reading.after: No communicative aperture is cut through to them: the address cannot cross into receptive space and return as response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 46:24 concerns a misread approaching cloud, not invocation grammar. It remains anchored in the focus contrast between call and true response: the context shows desire assigning an answering role to an arrival that reverses into harm. Downstream prose should call this an analogy for false-positive response, without relocating the grammatical heedlessness of 46:5 from recipients to callers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The call at words 4 and 17 and the denied answer at word 10 leave open how callers may mistake an event for the return they seek.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies directed appeal and creates the expectation into which an apparent answer can be projected.
The branch supplies genuine answering return and serves as the standard the projected response fails to meet.
The branch supplies something appearing from a direction and functions as the ambiguous arrival onto which hope is projected.
The branch holds rain and punishment together and supplies the reversal between desired answer and harmful actuality.
The branch supplies demand for accelerated arrival and explains the expectation that predisposes the observers to misrecognize it.
The branch supplies moving air rather than beneficent rain and carries the apparent answer into its destructive reversal.

changed_reading.before: A recipient's nonresponse can only appear as obvious silence.
changed_reading.after: The absence of a true answer may be masked by wishful interpretation: an approaching event can be assigned the role of reply even while carrying the opposite result.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapping of the calling root whose image is an encouragement to a fallen person to rise. It remains anchored in the focus call and resurrection noun and is activated by 46:33's contrast between death and effective power. Downstream prose should mark it as a faint material echo, not claim that the focus verb lexically means resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The call at words 4 and 17 is held beside the rising noun at word 14, allowing an exploratory question about whom a summons can actually raise.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch supplies a verbal encouragement for one who has stumbled to rise and turns the call into an exploratory raising summons.
The branch supplies bodily standing and gives the summons a concrete upward endpoint.
The branch supplies resurrection and scales the bodily rising image to the ayah's terminal horizon.
The branch supplies capacity that reaches effective action and identifies the power by which rising can actually occur.
The branch supplies loss of life and force as the condition no false addressee can reverse.

changed_reading.before: The callers seek ordinary aid from beings that remain silent until resurrection.
changed_reading.after: At the far exploratory edge, their call resembles a futile command to rise addressed to powers that cannot raise anyone; resurrection discloses the only effective capacity.

strongest_changes: The focus relation reverses in 46:31-32: failure to answer God's caller makes the hearer, not only the invoked object, the nonresponsive party and is explicitly named straying.
The immediate evidence challenge in 46:4 changes invocation from request alone into an unratified claim of patronage with no creative share, establishing record, or surviving trace.
Present heedlessness changes into future enmity and repudiation in 46:6, so silence is the first phase of a relation that eventually turns against its initiator.
The failed intermediaries of 46:28 were supposed to produce nearness and help but instead disappear, making the route of mediation itself fictive.
The accepted address of 46:15-16 and the failed sensory reception of 46:26 broaden response from audible reply to effective uptake, ethical change, and consequential acceptance.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly redistributed the same call-response mechanics across roles: false patrons fail to receive, worshippers fail to receive signs, attentive listeners become callers, and audiences are judged by whether they answer. Material branches also kept live a more unusual picture of response as a channel cut open across separation.
remaining_uncertainties: The claim-and-affiliation branch of the calling root may be a productive secondary coloring rather than the primary force of the focus verb.
The near-horizon reading of the besides-God construction may extend too readily from personal objects of worship to impersonal worldly benefit.
The aperture and raising-summons outliers depend on form-distant or non-dominant mappings and should remain exploratory analogies.
The mirrored reception model is relationally strong, but the grammar of heedlessness in 46:5 itself continues to predicate that state of the invoked recipients.
